newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-PORTO INCREASE LEAD AS BENFICA STUMBLE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PORTO INCREASE LEAD AS BENFICA STUMBLE.

text.p: Champions Porto saw their Portuguese championship lead extended to a commanding five points on Sunday when challengers Benfica were held 0-0 at home by Maritimo.
A crashing free-kick by Argentine striker Mauro Airez which bounced off the bar in the 69th minute was the closest the Lisbon team came to breaking down a determined Maritimo defence.
Porto found no such difficulties, beating Belenenses 2-0 away on Saturday with two strikes by Brazilian marksman Mario Jardel.
Benfica paraded new signings Dutch striker Glenn Helder and Brazilian midfielder Alexandre Amaral for the first time.
"They did nothing except defend. Still, I congratulate them on holding us at bay," said Benfica's coach Paulo Autuori.
Porto, unbeaten this season in both domestic and European competition, now have 35 points, with Benfica second and Sporting six points further behind in third.

Jardel scored both his goals in a two-minute burst midway through the first half and the champions, with striker Domingos Oliveira back after a four-month injury absence, were never seriously threatened.
